provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: The Witcher: Old World rulebook (Go On Board)

steps.text: Game Board in the middle
Shuffle the Action Cards; reveal until three 0-cost cards appear - place them on the 3 right-most slots
Shuffle the other revealed cards back; deck on its spot; reveal 3 more onto the remaining slots
Shuffle the Potion Cards facedown on their space
Attribute Trophy Cards: {t}

byPlayers.1: shuffle one of each type, draw 1 faceup, box the rest
byPlayers.2: one per Attribute on their spots, box the other 4
byPlayers.3: one per Attribute on their spots, box the other 4
byPlayers.4: all of them near the board
byPlayers.5: all of them near the board

steps.text: Event Deck in numerical order (do not shuffle), numbered backs up; shuffle the two Exploration Decks separately
Gold Tokens and both sets of Poker Dice near the board
Location Tokens by terrain (Forest, Mountain, Water), each pile shuffled facedown; 1 from each faceup on its slot
Monster Cards in 3 faceup piles by level; Monster Tokens in 3 shuffled facedown stacks by level
Draw {d}; one by each faceup Location Token

byPlayers.2: 2 Level I tokens and 1 Level II (starting player picks its terrain)

steps.text: Flip them, move each to its Location on the board; matching Monster Card below its Location Token
Shuffle the Monster Fight deck next to the board
Extra facedown stack of {n} random Level I Monster tokens by the Monster section
Starting Player: whoever last read a Witcher book (or random); everyone takes Action and Fight Help Cards
From the starting player's right, counter-clockwise: draw 2 Player Boards, keep 1
Scoring Token on the lowest spot of the Trophy Track
Witcher miniature with its colored ring on your School Location
5 cubes on level 1 of the 4 Attribute tracks and the Witcher level track
Witcher Trophy Cards equal to your number of opponents facedown under your board
Shield Marker on 1 of the Shield Track
Your 10 School starting cards shuffled facedown by your board
Starting cards and Gold by turn order: {t}
In turn order, each player raises one Attribute by 1 level
Solo: Solo-Help Card nearby; 3 Gold on your board; draw 5 cards
Return unused player components to the box
Solo: defeat all 3 monsters and gain the Attribute Trophy; count your turns
Starting Player: Movement and Actions phase
